name: Ground Zero
text: Lit by the first nuke: the map opens and Glow works from Wipe Day #1.
scene: the crater and its sign

name: Second Wind
text: Hustle holds 3 s (was 2) and drains 20% slower

name: Calloused Hands
text: Taps +50%

name: Whetstone
text: Taps carry +0.16% of supplies/s; a whetstone by the target throws sparks
scene: a whetstone on a stump beside the target; every tap throws a few sparks off it

name: Quick Fingers
text: Hustle tops out at ×2.25 (was ×2)

name: Keep Swinging
text: Unmanned lines keep running while Hustle is above zero, not just while you tap

name: Steady Breath I
text: Hustle holds +0.5 s

name: Lucky Swing
text: 5% of your taps crit for ×10

name: Heavy Haft
text: Fells need 20% fewer taps

name: Rhythm I
text: Hustle +0.25 a tap

name: Tool Rack
text: Grip rungs buy themselves the moment you can afford them (page open)

name: Slow Burn I
text: Hustle drains 10% slower

name: Iron Palms
text: Taps carry +0.15% more of supplies/s; Hustle holds 0.5 s longer

name: Steady Breath II
text: Hustle holds +0.5 s

name: Afterburn
text: Afterglow's half-life 5 → 7 min

name: Hard Graft I
text: All lines ×1.12

name: Work Song
text: Afterglow holds its full ×3 for the first minute; the crew sing while you work
scene: while Afterglow holds, the crew swing in time and sing (badly); a note floats over each

name: Wipe Day Rush
text: Afterglow holds ×5 for 60 min, then fades. Night Shift window ×0.5

name: Masks On
text: All lines ×2 while Afterglow lasts; the crew work on in gas masks
scene: while Afterglow lasts every crew member wears a gas mask; the filters puff at each cycle

name: Steady Breath III
text: Hustle holds +0.5 s

name: Steady Breath IV
text: Hustle holds +0.5 s

name: Hair Trigger
text: Rush fires itself the moment Hustle fills (page open)

name: Rhythm II
text: Hustle +0.25 a tap

name: Slow Burn II
text: Hustle drains 10% slower

name: Golden Chip
text: A run's 20th fell drops a golden chip: all lines ×1.5 for the rest of the run
scene: the 20th fell spits out a spinning gold chip that flies up and nails itself over the cabin door for the run

name: Rhythm III
text: Hustle +0.25 a tap

name: Long Dawn
text: Afterglow holds its full ×3 for the first 2 minutes

name: Rhythm IV
text: Hustle +0.25 a tap

name: Slow Burn III
text: Hustle drains 10% slower

name: Rhythm V
text: Hustle +0.25 a tap

name: Green Sky I
text: All lines ×1.25 while Afterglow lasts

name: Woodpile
text: Each fell this run stacks a log by the cabin: all lines +2% a log, up to +40%
scene: a log pile grows by the cabin, one log a fell up to 20; at 20 a gull takes the top log as its perch

name: Hard Graft II
text: All lines ×1.1

name: Hard Graft III
text: All lines ×1.1

name: Clear-Cut
text: While Afterglow lasts, fells need half the taps

name: Fever Pitch
text: Hustle peaks at ×6, not ×2; it holds 1.5 s less and drains ×3 as fast

name: Apprentice
text: While the page is open and you aren't tapping, an apprentice taps once a second
scene: a kid in a far too big hard hat chips at the target with a tiny hatchet whenever you stop

name: Hard Graft IV
text: All lines ×1.1

name: Hard Graft V
text: All lines ×1.1

name: Rhythm VI
text: Hustle +0.25 a tap

name: Muscle Memory
text: Hustle holds 0.5 s longer and fills 0.25 a tap faster (the tree's limits)

name: Green Sky II

text: All lines ×1.2; Hustle drains 10% slower

name: Rhythm VII
text: Hustle +0.25 a tap

name: Trophy Rack

scene: a plank rack by the cabin; each trophy is the run's last target in miniature: pine cone, geode, ore nugget, sulfur crystal or a rivet

name: Green Sky III
text: All lines ×1.25 while Afterglow lasts

name: Old Friends
text: Mara stays hired through every Wipe Day and rows back in with you
scene: Mara rows in with the crew at every landing and walks straight to the tideline

name: Fair Pay I
text: Hands cost ×0.95

name: Hiring Board
text: Dax stays hired through every Wipe Day too, and every hand costs ×0.9
scene: a hiring board by the cabin, one painted name per kept hand

name: Work Gang I
text: Twig-era lines +25%

text: All lines +1% a hand on shift (up to +5%), twice that while Afterglow lasts

name: Work Gang II

text: Runs start with 10 Looms, at work as soon as Timber opens

name: Pay Day
text: Ring the bell by the cabin once a run: manned lines ×3 for 5 minutes
scene: a rusty bell on a post by the cabin; rung, the crew cheer and toss their caps for 5 minutes (a scene object, never a Toolbelt button)

name: Crew Kit II
text: Runs start with 10 Workbenches, at work as soon as Timber opens

name: Full Crew

name: Fair Pay II
text: Hands cost ×0.85

name: Skeleton Crew
text: Hands cost nothing and manned lines pay ×2, but only five hands work at once

name: Bunkhouse
text: Rested hands: all lines cycle ×1.3 faster; the bunkhouse stands from the start
scene: a bunkhouse with a stove pipe and a washing line stands by the cabin from the first second of every run

name: Crew Spirit I
text: All lines +1.5% a hand on shift (up to ×1.21)

name: Crew Spirit II
text: All lines +2% a hand on shift (up to ×1.28)

name: Crew Spirit IV
text: All lines +2% a hand on shift (up to ×1.28)

name: Square Meals IV
text: All lines ×1.1

name: Square Meals VI
text: All lines ×1.1

name: Square Meals VII
text: All lines ×1.1

name: Crew Legends
text: All of Crew's ring 8 lit: all lines ×2
scene: every hand's name burned into a driftwood sign over the base door

name: Campfire Stories
text: All lines +0.1% for every Logbook page (up to ×1.15)

name: Lifers

text: Hands cost ×0.85 (second hands too)

name: Starter Kit
text: Start every run with 10 Beachcombers and 5 Campfires, already working.
scene: a packed crate rides in on the rowboat; at landing 10 Beachcombers and 5 Campfires pop in with their count badges

name: Hot Coals
text: Campfires +100%.

name: First Light
text: Beachcombers, Campfires and Gardens cycle twice as fast. Up at dawn.

name: Bulk Discount I
text: Line units cost ×0.9.

name: Bulk Buttons
text: Adds Next to the bulk toggle: buys just enough for each line's next milestone.

name: Elbow Grease I
text: All lines +15%.

name: Conveyor Belts
text: All lines +30%. Belts rattle between the buildings, carrying every product.
scene: rattling belts link the buildings; each line's product rides them to the base

name: Prefab Walls
text: Every run starts in the Timber era. The cabin comes flat-packed.
scene: the rebuild drops a flat-packed timber cabin instead of the twig lean-to

name: Bulk Discount II
text: Line units cost ×0.9.

name: Bigger Kit
text: Start every run with 25 Beachcombers, 25 Campfires and 25 Gardens.

name: Shop Floor
text: Line units cost ×0.85. The shop floor finally has a floor.

name: Retooling II
text: Stone lines +30%.

name: Union Rules
text: Every ×2 milestone pays ×2.2. The crew read the small print.

name: Bulk Discount III
text: Line units cost ×0.85.

name: Stone Foundations
text: Every run starts in the Stone era. Somebody finally poured concrete.
scene: the cabin lands on a poured stone footing, in Stone-era colours from the first second

name: Mass Production
text: Every line +2% per unit of it you own, up to ×8. Speed milestones do nothing.

name: Assembly Line
text: All lines +5% for every Works node you own, up to ×2.

name: Elbow Grease II
text: All lines ×1.3.

text: Line Mk II and III buy themselves when affordable, while the page is open.

name: Bulk Discount IV

text: Every run starts in the Sheet Metal era. Rain drums on tin, not on you.
scene: corrugated tin roofs on every building from the landing; rain drums on them

text: Armored lines ×1.3.

text: Reactors ×2.

scene: a smokestack on every building, puffing in time with its bar; gulls circle wide of them

name: Elbow Grease V
text: All lines ×1.3.

name: Bulk Discount VI
text: Line units cost ×0.85.

name: Rivet Gun
text: Armored lines ×2. Every plate gets a rivet, needed or not.
scene: riveted plates on the Ship Breaker and Reactor; a rivet gun's sparks flash on them now and then

name: Monoculture
text: The highest line you own ×2; every other line ×0.5. The rest can make do.

name: Overtime
text: Every line cycles twice as fast. Nobody asked the crew.

name: Retooling V
text: Armored lines ×1.3.

name: Hot Cells III
text: Reactors ×2.

name: Bulk Discount VII
text: Line units cost ×0.85.

text: Runs start with 25 of every open line, and lines ×4 while Afterglow lasts.
scene: the landing raises a whole town at its 25-owned stage at once; crews hammer on every roof while Afterglow lasts

name: Elbow Grease VI
text: All lines ×1.3.

name: The Works
text: All lines ×3. You built the whole works.

name: Retooling VI
text: Armored lines ×1.3.

name: Line Mk IV
text: Line Mk IV on the shelf (needs 100 owned): that line ×3, painted sign and all.
scene: a hand-painted Mk IV sign on every building that has one

name: Retooling VII
text: Sheet Metal lines ×1.5.

name: Lucky Tide
text: Flotsam drifts in 5% more often.
flavour: The sea seems to like you. Don't push it.

name: Slow Current I
text: Flotsam floats 1 s longer.

name: Lookout Post
text: A lookout points and a bell rings 3 s before flotsam drifts in.
scene: a lookout on a pole above the beach points out to sea and swings a ship's bell before each arrival
flavour: The kid with the spyglass finally earns his beans.

name: Driftwood I
text: Beachcombers +50%.

name: Rally Cry
text: Flotsam pays 5% more, Rallies included; the crew cheer each Rally.
scene: the crew throw their arms up and cheer when a Rally starts
flavour: Nothing lifts spirits like a drum of diesel in the surf.

name: Slow Current II
text: Flotsam floats 2 s longer.

name: Rainmaker
text: In rain, flotsam floats 10 s longer.
flavour: Bad weather, good pickings.

name: Circling Gulls
text: Gulls circle anything afloat: flotsam floats 3 s longer.
scene: two gulls circle each flotsam until it is caught or sinks
flavour: They want the fish. You want the crate. Everyone wins.

name: Driftwood II
text: Beachcombers +60%.

name: Life Raft
text: New flotsam (4%): a castaway rows in and mans your top unmanned line for 10 min.
scene: a castaway in a patched raft rows in, works the line, waves and rows off
flavour: Won't say where he's from. Works for beans.

name: Storm Drift
text: In rain, flotsam floats 3 s longer.

name: High Water
text: Flotsam floats 3 s longer (25 s, the most); the tide line rises.
scene: the waterline sits higher up the beach, so flotsam beaches closer to the camp
flavour: The sea meets you halfway now.

name: Slow Current III
text: Flotsam floats 3 s longer.

name: Drag Line
text: Flotsam you miss snags on a line and waits on the shore, one at a time.
scene: a float line strung across the shallows; a snagged catch bobs at its end
flavour: What the sea takes, the rope hands back.

name: Beach Camp I
text: Twig-era lines ×1.3.

name: Storm Harvest
text: In rain, all lines ×1.4 and flotsam floats 2 s longer.
flavour: Storm's coming. Get the barrels out.

name: Scavenger's Eye
text: Every flotsam is a Fuel Drum (Sealed Lockers aside): no crates, kits or bottles.
flavour: If it floats and it isn't diesel, you didn't see it.

name: Beachcomber's Net
text: Drift Crates catch themselves while the page is open.
scene: a net on two posts at the tideline scoops crates ashore
flavour: Mara strung it up and went back to sorting.

name: Sea Wall I
text: All lines ×1.1.

name: Deep Nets I
text: Docks ×2.

name: Flare Gun
text: Choose what your Flare calls: any kind but the Sealed Locker and the Bottle.
flavour: Red for diesel, green for crates. Nobody remembers blue.

name: Breakwater
text: Beachcombers, Docks and Ship Breakers ×1.5; car hulks shelter the bay.
scene: a curved breakwater of rusted car hulks and tyres across the mouth of the bay
flavour: Forty dead hatchbacks and one good idea.

name: Rain Barrels
text: In rain, all lines ×2.

name: Tide Pump
text: Every line cycles 10% faster; a tide pump creaks at the water's edge.
scene: a timber tide pump at the water's edge, its rocking beam nodding with the waves and faster in rain (the island's Tide Mill upgrade keeps the waterwheel)
flavour: Free power twice a day. The moon foots the bill.

name: Driftwood III
text: Beachcombers ×2.

name: Rogue Wave
text: Once a run, tap the surf: a big wave rolls in carrying a Drift Crate.
scene: while it is ready the surf glows; a tall wave curls in and drops a crate on the sand
flavour: Stand back from the beach. No, further.

name: Sea Wall II
text: All lines ×1.1.

name: Cutting Torch I
text: Ship Breakers ×2.

name: Beach Camp II
text: Twig-era lines ×1.5.

name: Sea Wall III
text: All lines ×1.1.

name: Lost Cargo
text: New flotsam (3%): a shipping container; line units cost half for 5 min.
scene: a rusted shipping container drifts in, beaches and swings its doors open
flavour: Manifest: 400 left boots, one forklift, no keys.

name: Sea Wall IV
text: All lines ×1.1.

name: Cutting Torch II
text: Ship Breakers ×2.

name: Bottle Post
text: Messages in a Bottle wash up twice as often (1%); each still holds a crate.
flavour: Most say 'help'. A few say where the good stuff is.

name: Wreckers' Moon
text: A Drift Crate washes up for each hour away, up to 12; online flotsam ×0.5.
scene: a lantern burns on the rocks at night; by morning crates lie along the beach
flavour: Hang a lantern on the rocks and see what the night brings in.

name: Auto Flare
text: Your Flare fires itself when it's ready and nothing floats, page open.
flavour: It goes off on its own. Like most things here.

name: Deep Nets II
text: Docks ×2.

name: Driftwood IV
text: Beachcombers ×2.

name: Beach Camp III
text: Twig-era lines ×1.5.

name: Tide Tables
text: A tide clock shows when the next three flotsam arrive, and what they are.
flavour: Printed before the war. The sea never read the news.

name: Sea Wall V
text: All lines ×1.1.

name: King Tide
text: All lines ×1.2; the sea floods the low beach.
scene: the sea floods the low beach into a shallow lagoon; the camp stands at the new edge
flavour: Wet boots, full pockets.

name: Relit Lighthouse
text: All lines ×1.1; the lighthouse on the far island burns again at night.
scene: the dark lighthouse on the far island (terrain.back) lights up and sweeps the bay at night
flavour: No ship has come in years. It's for us.

name: Weather Buoy
text: A buoy shows the island's next 24 h of weather, so you can plan for rain.
scene: a striped buoy with a blinking light bobs off the point; tap it for the forecast
flavour: Beeps all night. Never wrong.

name: Deep Nets III
text: Docks ×2.

name: Hot Breakfast
text: Back after 6 h or more? Collect also starts a Rally: all lines ×4 for 60 s.
scene: On a return after 6 h or more the crew sit round the fire with a steaming pot of beans while the Rally runs.

name: Deep Cellars
text: Night Shift +4 h.
scene: A wooden cellar hatch in the ground beside the cabin, from the first second of every run.

name: Night Lamps
text: Lines +20% at night. Lanterns go up on every building after dusk.
scene: After dusk a lantern hangs on every building, drawn on the lights layer above the night tint.

name: Lantern Oil I
text: Lines +10% at night.

name: Insulated Walls
text: Night Shift +4 h. Shutters go up and the draughts stay out.
scene: Plank shutters on the cabin windows; they swing shut at dusk.

name: Lantern Oil II
text: Lines +30% at night.

name: All Clear
text: Lines +50% while Afterglow lasts. The siren winds down; the crew climb out.
scene: A hand-cranked siren on a pole by the hatch wails at the landing, and kept hands climb out of the hatch instead of the rowboat.

name: Moonshine Still
text: Lines +1% at night per Bunker node you own, up to +10%. It's lamp fuel. Mostly.
scene: A dented copper still by the cellar hatch, bubbling and dripping at night.

name: Root Cellar I
text: Night Shift +4 h.

name: Night Porter
text: Collect runs itself 3 s after the welcome-back card opens; the card stays.

name: Root Cellar II
text: Night Shift +4 h.

name: Snug
text: Lines ×1.1 while you're away. Blankets, a stove and a door that shuts.

name: Fuel Cache
text: Oil Presses +60%.

name: Banked Fires
text: Campfires, Kilns and Furnaces ×2 at night. The fires are banked, never out.
scene: At night the Campfire, Kiln and Furnace glow twice as bright on the lights layer, embers drifting up.

name: Night Rations I
text: Lines ×1.1 while you're away.

name: Night Owls
text: Lines +2% at night for each hand on shift, up to +28%. Hire before bed.

name: Bunker Mentality
text: Lines ×1.5 while you're away. No flotsam drifts in, ever.
scene: While slotted, the hatch stays bolted and a hand-painted sign on it reads GONE TO GROUND.

name: Wake-up Call
text: Grit fires itself on your first visit after it is ready.

name: Lantern Oil III
text: Lines ×1.3 at night.

name: Root Cellar III
text: Night Shift +4 h.

name: Cold Storage
text: Night Shift +4 h, and lines ×1.15 while you're away. The beans keep.
scene: A frosted steel door set into the hill behind the cabin, a thermometer nailed beside it.

name: Lantern Oil IV
text: Lines ×1.5 at night.

name: Night Rations II
text: Lines ×1.1 while you're away.

name: Lights Out
text: Say when you'll be back. Return within 30 min of it: the Night Shift pays ×1.1.
scene: While you're away, a hand-painted BACK AT 08:00 board hangs on the cabin door (the time is a screen-space label).

name: Tinned Beans I
text: Lines ×1.3.

name: Snooze
text: 'Night Shift over' rings an hour early, while there's still time to top up.

name: Root Cellar IV
text: Night Shift +4 h.

name: Tinned Beans II
text: Lines ×1.4.

name: Tinned Beans III
text: Lines ×1.4.

name: Night Rations III
text: Lines ×1.1 while you're away.

name: Night Crew
text: Lines without a hand work the Night Shift at 10%. Head-torches bob all night.
scene: At night small head-torch lights bob over every plot that has no hand, on the lights layer.

name: Night Rations IV
text: Lines ×1.1 while you're away.

name: Steel Plating I
text: Sheet Metal lines ×1.5.

name: Bunk Beds
text: Night Shift +4 h: the window reaches 48 h, the most it gets.

name: Graveyard Shift
text: Lines ×4 at night but ×0.5 always: double after dark, half by day.
scene: While slotted, by day the crew doze in hammocks strung between the buildings; after dark every building blazes with work lights.

name: Shift Report
text: The welcome-back card breaks the night down, line by line.

name: Tinned Beans IV
text: Lines ×1.4.

name: Tinned Beans V
text: Lines ×1.35.

name: Tinned Beans VI
text: Lines ×1.2.

name: Dug In
text: Lines +0.5% per Bunker node you own, up to +20%. Nobody's moving us.
scene: Sandbags ring the hatch and a periscope pokes out of the hill, turning to follow passing gulls.

name: Tinned Beans VII
text: Lines ×1.2.

name: Deep Sleep
text: Lines ×1.1 while you're away. The whole crew sleeps like logs.
scene: At night a slow stream of Zzz drifts up out of the cellar hatch.

name: Tinned Beans VIII
text: Lines ×1.1.

name: Bunker Door
text: Away 24 h or more? A Fuel Drum and a Drift Crate wait at a door in the hill.
scene: A steel door in the hillside; after a long absence it stands ajar with a drum and a crate outside, to tap.

name: Steel Plating II
text: Sheet Metal lines ×1.5.

name: Souvenir Jar
text: Afterglow's half-life +1 min. A jar on the shelf fills with glass.
scene: a jar on the cabin shelf, a little fuller of glass each Wipe Day

name: Bigger Payload
text: Crater glass +10% from every nuke.

name: Forecast
text: The Big Red's card tells you when the next Wipe Day will count, at this rate.

name: Warm Embers I
text: Afterglow's half-life +60 s.

name: Tinfoil Hats

name: Bigger Payload II
text: Crater glass ×1.1.

name: Glow Lamp

scene: a green lamp on the Kettle's pad, its glow on the lights layer

name: Flight School

name: Fertile Ash I
text: Gardens +60%.

name: Quick Rebuild
text: Rebuild in one tap: skip the rebuild screen and keep your last loadout.

name: Fertile Ash II
text: Twig lines +30%.

scene: glass shards glitter along the crater rim (lights layer)

name: Warm Embers II
text: Afterglow's half-life +60 s.

name: Crater Lake
text: Glow factor +0.02. Rain pools in the crater; the gulls approve.
scene: a glassy pool in the crater's low end, with a gull paddling in it

name: Bigger Payload III
text: Crater glass ×1.1.

name: Blast Radius
text: All lines +0.5% for every lit Blast node, up to ×1.1.

name: Hot Core
text: Crater glass ×1.5, but lines run at a quarter while Afterglow lasts.

name: Glass Strata
text: Glow factor +0.001 for every Wipe Day, up to +0.02.

name: Warm Embers III
text: Afterglow's half-life +90 s.

name: Bright Glass I
text: Glow factor +0.04.

name: Dead Hand
text: An opt-in switch that presses the Big Red for you while the page is open.

name: Fertile Ash III
text: All lines ×1.18.

name: Shockwave I
text: All lines run 18% faster.

name: Postcard Album
text: Your last 20 postcards, each with a snapshot of the island you flattened.

name: Bigger Payload IV
text: Crater glass ×1.1.

name: Ash Bloom
text: While Afterglow lasts, every line ×2. Odd flowers push up through the ash.
scene: pale, faintly glowing flowers push up through the ash while Afterglow lasts

name: Bright Glass II
text: Glow factor +0.04.

name: Shockwave II
text: All lines run 10% faster.

name: Fertile Ash IV
text: All lines ×1.13.

name: Shockwave III
text: All lines run 10% faster.

name: Double Barrel

scene: a smaller twin Kettle stands beside the first on the pad; the film launches both

name: Shockwave IV

name: Bigger Payload V
